description: Data table with search, filters, sorting, pagination and content states.

howToUse: Use it when people compare the same fields across many records: each column is a field and each row is one record.
Align numbers and amounts with `align="num"`, so digits line up on the right.
Turn on `searchable` for long lists, and `filterable` on columns with a few repeated values, such as status or owner.
Mark `sortable` only on the columns people sort by, such as date or amount.
When a row opens a detail, pass `onRowClick` and `rowLabel`, which names the row for screen readers.
Show `loading`, `error` and `empty` in place of the rows instead of hiding the table.
On mobile, set `minTableWidth`: the table scrolls sideways instead of squeezing the columns.
alternatives: Records that move between stages: KanbanBoard.
A few items with image and text: ContentCard in a grid.
Thousands of rows on a server: search and paginate on the server, and pass only the current page to the table.

keyboard.action: Moves through search, filters, sortable headers, rows and pagination, in that order. Rows receive focus only when `onRowClick` is set.
Sorts the column: ascending, descending, then back to the original order.

props.description: Search field above the table filtering the rows.

props.description: Search criterion. Default: any value in the row contains the text.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows skeleton rows and marks the composition as busy.

props.name: error
props.description: Replaces the rows with an announced error.

props.name: minTableWidth
props.description: Minimum table width; the container then scrolls horizontally.
